title: Hot Gooey Japanese Rocket Yakitori
description: A romantic Japanese dish from Kyushu featuring fermented and gooey rocket, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill, this gluten-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sake, mirin, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the rocket leaves to the marinade and let it sit for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator to allow the fermentation process to start.
Thread the marinated rocket leaves onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each leaf.
Brush the sesame oil onto the grill to prevent sticking.
Grill the rocket skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are slightly charred and gooey.
Brush the yakitori sauce onto the rocket leaves during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the hot gooey Japanese rocket yakitori immediately, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions if desired.
